name: How do contractors add square footage to an existing bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do contractors add square footage to an existing bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expanding a bathroom requires either reallocating interior square footage or building an exterior bump-out addition. You can borrow space from an adjacent closet, hallway, or underused bedroom, which avoids altering your home exterior. Alternatively, a small home addition pushes your exterior walls outward to create an entirely new footprint. Your existing floor plan, structural framing, and whether adjacent walls are load-bearing will determine the best path forward. During an initial consultation, a contractor evaluates your layout to see whether shifting interior walls or framing a home addition best fits your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors expand a bathroom by taking space from adjacent closets or rooms, or by building an exterior room addition to push the home's footprint outward.
